paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Ketubot 33a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.33a.7); Hyman infers from the passage that he lived in Abaye’s time.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage names Rav Sama son of Rav Yirmeyah as raising the objection, and [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2803&lang=en) cites the same folio. Hyman infers the chronology.
